# Rubric, version 1.0-draft

A reviewer answers nine questions about one result photo. The questions never change. Points are computed from the answers by `onmodel/scoring.py`.

## The nine questions

| Item | Dimension | Question |
|---|---|---|
| `shape` | fidelity | Does the product have the same silhouette, proportions and construction details as in the real product photo? |
| `color` | fidelity | Does the product have the same hue, saturation and brightness (including how dark black stays)? |
| `material` | fidelity | Does the product have the same finish and texture (glass transparency, metal reflections, lace, fabric or print pattern)? |
| `text` | fidelity | Is every printed word, letter, number and logo identical to the real product, character by character? (No text on the product: same.) |
| `parts` | fidelity | Does the photo show the same parts as the real product: none missing, none extra, none merged? |
| `pose` | pose | Does the result follow the pose reference's pose, framing and camera angle? |
| `identity` | identity | Is the person the same as in the pose reference (or the chosen model), and is no hand, mannequin or person from the product photo carried in? |
| `artifacts` | artifacts | Is the photo free of anatomy errors (five fingers per hand), deformation, stray text, watermarks and melted objects? |
| `scale` | scale | Is the product's real-world size right relative to the body or a reference object? (Not applicable when size cannot be judged.) |

## Answers and points

| Answer | Points | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| `same` | 2 | nothing is wrong |
| `minor` | 1 | the difference is visible but does not damage the photo |
| `different` | 0 | the difference is clear |
| `cannot_tell` | 1 | you cannot see enough to decide. On a product-fidelity item it blocks Verified; on any other item it costs one point |
| `not_applicable` | 2 | the question does not apply (for example, no pose reference was given) |

## Dimensions and the verdict

Product fidelity is the lowest of its five items (`shape`, `color`, `material`, `text`, `parts`), so it is 2 only when all five are `same`. The other items (`pose`, `identity`, `artifacts`, `scale`) are one dimension each. Five dimensions of 0 to 2 give a total out of 10.

**Verified** = product fidelity 2 / 2, and total at least 8, and no veto defect.

## Defect codes

List every problem you found with one of these codes. A veto code blocks Verified whatever the points say.

| Code | Item | Veto | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `WRONG_PRODUCT` | `shape` | yes | A different product from the real one. |
| `SHAPE_OFF` | `shape` | no | Silhouette or construction details differ. |
| `LENGTH_DRIFT` | `shape` | no | Hem or length follows the pose reference instead of the product. |
| `COLOR_OFF` | `color` | no | Shade or saturation shifted, same color family. |
| `COLOR_FAMILY` | `color` | yes | Wrong color family. |
| `MATERIAL_OFF` | `material` | no | Finish or texture differs (glass, metal, lace, print). |
| `TEXT_GARBLE` | `text` | no | Small print is gibberish or unreadable. |
| `TEXT_WRONG` | `text` | yes | A large word or logo is wrong, missing or invented. |
| `LABEL_OCCLUDED` | `text` | no | Fingers or props cover the printed text. |
| `PART_MISSING` | `parts` | yes | A part of the product is missing. |
| `PART_MERGED` | `parts` | yes | Two parts were merged into one. |
| `PART_EXTRA` | `parts` | yes | A part that the product does not have was added. |
| `POSE` | `pose` | no | Pose or framing differs from the reference. |
| `IDENTITY` | `identity` | no | The person differs from the reference or the chosen model. |
| `LEAK_HAND_MANNEQUIN` | `identity` | yes | A hand, mannequin or person from the product photo appears in the result. |
| `ARTIFACT` | `artifacts` | no | Anatomy error, stray text, watermark or melted object. |
| `SEVERE_DEFORMITY` | `artifacts` | yes | A severe deformity of the product or the body. |
| `SCALE_OFF` | `scale` | no | The product looks too big or too small for the body. |

Veto codes: `WRONG_PRODUCT`, `COLOR_FAMILY`, `TEXT_WRONG`, `PART_MISSING`, `PART_MERGED`, `PART_EXTRA`, `LEAK_HAND_MANNEQUIN`, `SEVERE_DEFORMITY`.

## Status and versioning

This is a draft (1.0-draft). The point values, the minimum total of 8 and the list of veto codes are starting values: they have not been calibrated against human labels yet (see [calibration](../docs/calibration.md)). Any change to them raises `rubric_version`, and every judgment record carries the version it was scored with, so results are only comparable within one version.

See also [verified](verified.md), [failure taxonomy](failure-taxonomy.md), [judge protocol](judge-protocol.md) and [hard rules](hard-rules.md).
